The '''Malastare Cloudburst''' was a type of beverage. A full-strength Malastare Cloudburst was harmful to [[Human/Legends|Humans]] but safe to drink for [[Gran/Legends|Gran]]s. A lot of Humans on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] thought they could handle a full-strength Malastare Cloudburst, as many [[Nightclub/Legends|clubs]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] diluted the intoxicant with less harmful liquids to avoid legal repercussions.<ref name="FF44" />
